CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a trucking shot matching the subject's walking pace on a 90mm tilt-shift, framing with diagonal dynamic balance across the frame.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with bare-bulb specular light producing tight, hot speculars; grade as warm amber highlights rolling into cool slate shadows. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.
